company_summary.one_line_business.value: Viavi Solutions Inc. (VIAVI, also referred to as the Company, we, our and us) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace and critical infrastructure.

value.summary: In support of our business segments, we are pursuing a corporate strategy that we believe will best position us for future opportunities as follows: •Defend and consolidate leadership in core business segments: –NSE: Lab-to-Field integration across NE Platforms; integration between NE and SE platforms; and –OSP: continued innovation in anti-counterfeiting pigments and 3D sensing. •Invest in secular trends to drive growth and expand total addressable market (TAM): –Fiber densification: Fiber-to-the-everywhere (FTTx), cable, wireless backhaul and data centers; –Wireless: 5G-to-6G evolution, Open Radio Access Network (ORAN), AI-RAN, RAN optimization, private 5G networks and intelligent edge; and –High-performance optical applications: free-space optical communications, quantum key distribution and quantum computing and automotive LiDAR. •Extend VIAVI technologies and platforms into lucrative adjacent markets and applications: –Expand and grow mission-critical applications such as aerospace and defense, resilient positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) and network security; and –Transform and extend SE business unit through cloud-centric architecture, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), analytics, automation and security.

ai_exposure.summary: In support of our business segments, we are pursuing a corporate strategy that we believe will best position us for future opportunities as follows: •Defend and consolidate leadership in core business segments: –NSE: Lab-to-Field integration across NE Platforms; integration between NE and SE platforms; and –OSP: continued innovation in anti-counterfeiting pigments and 3D sensing. •Invest in secular trends to drive growth and expand total addressable market (TAM): –Fiber densification: Fiber-to-the-everywhere (FTTx), cable, wireless backhaul and data centers; –Wireless: 5G-to-6G evolution, Open Radio Access Network (ORAN), AI-RAN, RAN optimization, private 5G networks and intelligent edge; and –High-performance optical applications: free-space optical communications, quantum key distribution and quantum computing and automotive LiDAR. •Extend VIAVI technologies and platforms into lucrative adjacent markets and applications: –Expand and grow mission-critical applications such as aerospace and defense, resilient positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) and network security; and –Transform and extend SE business unit through cloud-centric architecture, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), analytics, automation and security.

translation_zh_tw.company_summary: Viavi Solutions Inc.（VIAVI，亦稱本公司、我們、我們的及吾人）是全球提供電信、雲端、企業、第一應變者、軍事、航空航太及關鍵基礎設施的網路測試、監控及保障解決方案的供應商。
customer_types: 超大規模資料中心營運商

ai_exposure.summary: 為支持我們的事業部門，我們正推行一項企業策略，旨在使我們在未來機會中處於最佳位置，具體如下：• 防衛並鞏固核心事業部門的領導地位：– NSE：從實驗室到現場整合跨NE Platforms；NE與SE平台間的整合；及 – OSP：持續創新防偽顏料及3D感測。• 投資於長期趨勢以驅動成長及擴大總可服務市場（TAM）：– 光纖密集化：Fiber-to-the-everywhere（FTTx）、電纜、無線回傳及資料中心；– 無線：5G至6G演進、Open Radio Access Network（ORAN）、AI-RAN、RAN優化、私有5G網路及智慧邊緣；及 – 高效能光學應用：自由空間光通訊、量子金鑰分配與量子計算及汽車LiDAR。• 將 VIAVI 技術及平台延伸至有利可圖的鄰近市場及應用：– 擴大及發展任務關鍵應用，如航空航太與國防、有韌性的定位、導航與時間（PNT）及網路安全；及 – 透過以雲端為中心的架構、人工智慧（AI）與機器學習（ML）、分析、自動化與安全，轉型並擴展 SE 事業部門。
